games.payoutNote: Same mechanic/prize structure as other states' Cash POP (IN/ME/MD/MS/MO/NC): the dollar prize is a random multiplier of your wager (5x-250x at $1, confirmed from valottery.com's own Cash Pop Prizes & Odds table) assigned per ticket at play time, not determined by which number you picked. The app can only tell you whether your number matched, not your exact prize.
